subject: E-Commerce
title: The Paradox of Choice
description: Learn The Paradox of Choice in one minute.

hook.text: Amazon offers 350 million products. Studies show that too many choices make people buy less, not more.

buildup.text: Psychologist Barry Schwartz proved that more options create anxiety, decision fatigue, and regret.

discovery.text: Amazon solves this with 'Best Seller' badges and 'Amazon's Choice' labels. They curate within the chaos.

twist.text: Amazon's Choice is algorithmic, not editorial. It often highlights products with high return rates.

climax.text: The illusion of choice matters more than actual choice. Curated recommendations feel like freedom.

punchline.text: 350 million products, but we buy what algorithms pick.

quiz.question: What does the 'paradox of choice' mean for online shopping?
options: Too many options create anxiety and reduce purchases
